top_violation_types.title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors have not been inspected monthly.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children were observed watching mickey mouse during snack time    This was corrected during the inspection when I observed the caregiver turn off the tablet and closed it.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One  record reviewed with a Health Statement indicating one will be obtained within 12 months of enrollment and was not obtained. Enrollment date showed 1/17/24.

top_violation_types.title: Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §747.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregivers record lacked a notarized affidavit.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Caregivers - Orientation (26 TAC §747.1303(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The assistant caregiver's orientation checklist was not available to review during the inspection time.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider could not provide annual training hours during inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.
